title: Triage current production dependency advisories
expected_value: Flagship golden-workflow reliability; scores are planning estimates, not health metrics.
test_requirements: Reproduce on isolated exact source; preserve baseline/fixed evidence, appropriate build/tests and golden path; source reading is not interactive sign-off.

direct: Isolated clean npm ci resolved next@16.3.4; npm audit --omit=dev reported 1 critical Next.js, 2 high dependency advisories (sharp, source-map-js). No next/og or ImageResponse reference found in source search. KNOWN_ISSUES.md:32 says no known high-severity production advisory.
hypothesis: The Next.js RCE advisory may be unreachable if the vulnerable ImageResponse route is not exposed; exploitability and runtime dependency reachability are unverified.

next_action: Inspect dependency path and deployed Next/Vinext routes; upgrade to an unaffected compatible release in isolation and rerun audit, build, and tests.
